defects_found_by_earlier_attempts_and_fi: the bridge required an explicit model load; requests now load their model on demand
a thinking model was silent past ReqLLM's 30-second stream wait; thinking now streams as reasoning_content and the child request sets receive_timeout
token-sized reasoning deltas each became a ReqLLM reasoning record and exceeded the 120000-byte context budget; reasoning is now sent in batches
expression cells without return evaluated to null; a single expression now returns its value and an empty result says so

system_prompt_guidance: For a local WebLLM model without parallel tool calls or image input, the composed system prompt includes: 'Use small explicit steps and verify intermediate facts rather than assuming a long implicit reasoning chain.' 'Do not claim to inspect images; request a supported representation through an approved host capability.' 'Issue tool calls sequentially; this model does not advertise parallel tool calling.' and lists only the granted tools.

cross_origin_blockers.openai_inference: POST https://api.openai.com/v1/responses returned 200 without Access-Control-Allow-Origin; Chromium reported corsError MissingAllowOriginHeader and net::ERR_FAILED
cross_origin_blockers.openai_auth: OpenID discovery and JWKS on auth.openai.com returned no Access-Control-Allow-Origin, so the page could not complete sign-in

upstream_findings: ReqLLM streaming is tied to Finch.stream/5; a per-request transport (vendored change) lets providers run elsewhere
ReqLLM has no way for a provider to declare that it needs no credentials; OhMyJido now honours credentials_required?/0
ReqLLM's default response builder keeps one reasoning_details record per streamed reasoning chunk, so token-sized reasoning_content streams grow history by about 150 bytes per token
limitations: Real GPU runs need a WebGPU browser outside WSLg; the automated suites use a fake engine
Sessions in the page last as long as the page; no IndexedDB-backed Jido.Storage adapter is shipped
The Qwen3.8-27B q3f16_1 weights were still downloading at a 2 MiB/s cap when this record was written; its model library is compiled but the model has not run
